Implemented Linux-only swipe-to-seek feedback:

- **Center seek indicator removed on Linux** (no `hero-seek-hud` overlay while dragging).
- **Horizontal swipe updates the bottom folder/crumb line while scrubbing**, showing:
  - target position
  - total duration
  - progress (percent)
- **Feedback clears shortly after gesture end** (post-release delay).

### Code changes
- `lib/widgets/hero_feedback_surface.dart`
  - Added `showCenterSeekHud`, `onSeekPreviewUpdate`, `onSeekPreviewEnd`
  - Calls preview update continuously during drag; clears via `onSeekPreviewEnd` after release.
- `lib/screens/void_screen.dart`
  - On `Platform.isLinux`, wires preview updates into the bottom crumb line.
  - Added `ValueKey('void-hero-feedback-surface')` so the gesture can be driven externally (and so the screenshot capture can reliably drag the hero).

### Screenshots
Generated on Linux with a real swipe gesture:

- During-gesture screenshot:  
  `.tmp/agent_shots/during_swipe_to_seek_linux.png`
- Post-gesture (cleared) screenshot:  
  `.tmp/agent_shots/post_swipe_to_seek_linux.png`

Implemented Linux-only swipe-to-seek feedback:

- **Center seek indicator removed on Linux** (no `hero-seek-hud` overlay while dragging).
- **Horizontal swipe updates the bottom folder/crumb line while scrubbing**, showing:
  - target position
  - total duration
  - progress (percent)
- **Feedback clears shortly after gesture end** (post-release delay).

### Code changes
- `lib/widgets/hero_feedback_surface.dart`
  - Added `showCenterSeekHud`, `onSeekPreviewUpdate`, `onSeekPreviewEnd`
  - Calls preview update continuously during drag; clears via `onSeekPreviewEnd` after release.
- `lib/screens/void_screen.dart`
  - On `Platform.isLinux`, wires preview updates into the bottom crumb line.
  - Added `ValueKey('void-hero-feedback-surface')` so the gesture can be driven externally (and so the screenshot capture can reliably drag the hero).

### Screenshots
Generated on Linux with a real swipe gesture:

- During-gesture screenshot:  
  `.tmp/agent_shots/during_swipe_to_seek_linux.png`
- Post-gesture (cleared) screenshot:  
  `.tmp/agent_shots/post_swipe_to_seek_linux.png`
